title: A draft PR that no live session owns and no doing step names closes as stale
why: The open-PR count was 763 at 21:00 CST Nov 9; the owner wants it down to live work (owner chat 21:27 and 21:29 CST: "the amt of open prs we have now is not best practices"). The 170 was only the band #3111 to #3396 (179 drafts there: 9 LIVE, 170 UNKNOWN). Counts, all 541: LIVE 10 (#3005, #3212, #3223, #3250, #3251, #3253, #3285, #3318, #3391, #3396), REPLACED 2 (#1552 by merged #3010, body 'Replaces draft #1552'; #1844 by merged #3104, body 're-land of PR #1844'; both sent to runner 10 to close, coordinator 17:27 CST, titles read) and #2680 moved to UNKNOWN (coordinator 17:28: #3404 says 'Builds on #2680', not 'replaces', and #2680's log-after-cd half is not named in #3404; unread; mergeable state dirty). The coordinator said GO at 17:28 on the next sort, read-only: #3154's verdicts.tsv and part3-subsumed.tsv against the 508 UNKNOWN; an Explore agent runs it and reports to the coordinator, LIVE-REPLACEMENT 20 (the replacer is open: #1386, #1708, #1760, #1784, #1789, #1938, #2083, #2197, #2226, #2463, #2677, #2740, #2771, #2797, #2826, #2892; partial: #1616, #1618, #1748, #2763), UNKNOWN 509 after the ledger sort below. Nothing closed; closing is the batch runner's act (ruling pr-close-by-batch-runner) on the coordinator's order. LEDGER SORT DONE by 17:33 CST Nov 14 (coordinator's GO at 17:28; read-only Explore agent on Sonnet, GET reads; triage read none). The UNKNOWN set is 509, not 508 (it holds #3154 itself and #2680). The ledger is #3154's head 11f212f4b0c8 (draft), files docs/plans/backlog-drain/verdicts.txt, part3-subsumed.txt and close-evidence.txt (not docs/backlog-drain/*.tsv). #3154's body is stale: it says 234 rows; verdicts.txt has 451 (keep 196, close 101, fresh 90, rebuild 64; fresh means under 48 h old, left with runner 10, not judged). No file carries a date or a README; the commits run Nov 13 16:59Z to 21:35Z. Of the 509 the ledger names 320 (keep 176, rebuild 27, close 35, fresh 82) and misses 189 (41 created before its 'covers all PRs' commit, oldest #2160, reason unknown; 148 after). Close rows with a merged replacer, REST this run: one, #1509 by merged #2461 (Batch 69, merged Nov 9 21:13Z; ledger evidence is main commit 8705f9a93, whose subject matches #1509; caveats: the ledger names a commit, not a replacer PR; content not diffed; #1509's head has diverged). CLOSE ORDER NONE this round (coordinator 17:34 CST Nov 14, relayed; it did not diff the code): #1509 is not ordered, replaced-by-#2461 is plausible, unproven: #2461's own lane list (28 PRs) does not include #1509 or #1186, only its Retire-run row names the debt; main already reads a script file from disk (hooks/guard_frozen.py line 1744, _SCRIPT_READ_LIMIT, interpreter_write_hit), so the capability looks landed, but under a different cap name than #1509's MESSAGE_FILE_MAX; #1509 is dirty on a base of Nov 7 and stays open. #1871, #1971 and #2845 are not closed either. The sweep is off the CI-speed path: the coordinator stops after this read; next sort only if the owner asks. The other 34 close rows have NO merged replacer (26 an open draft; 4 name none: #1314 and #2097 cite content on main, #1377 a dropped design, #2173 a step skipped on a measured false-alarm rate; 5 reach an open PR only through a closed hop). The ledger's own later disposition of the 35: close-after-home-filed 20, close-ok 8, hold-stacked 3 (#2099, #2735, #2750), keep-open 4 (#2714, #2727, #2845, #2938). Do NOT close #1871 on the ledger: it says 'inside #2067', and #2067 was closed unmerged Nov 14 06:11Z with 'fixes fold into #1871' (circular). #1971's replacer #2123 was closed unmerged as 'replaced by #3249' (open draft). #2845's close holds only while #2869 or #2871 stays keep; #2871 is now closed unmerged. Build caveats: the page file is 14.0 MB of the 16 MB cap; PR rows carry no head shas, so rows that read a head show unknown; 2067 session rows carried unverified, so the build's 384 stalled-step lines are unknown; the build's hint "set to done: landed in #..." for records-page-before-ready is wrong (#3396 and #3426 are open). 23:34 CST Nov 14 (lane on 3255, 3154, 3212): PR #3154 (backlog-drain ledger) is a CLOSE candidate: base 996 commits behind main, body does not match its files (lane's read, unchecked by triage). The lane did not close it. Not an owner pick; runner 10 and the coordinator decide. 00:27 CST Nov 15 (coordinator message 00:28 CST, relayed): PR #3154 (backlog-drain ledger): close; runner 10 archives, comments, closes; no review or lint. coordinator's pick under the owner's 20:18 words, not the owner's; undoable only if the branch is archived first (archive/<branch> pushed before any delete); the coordinator says runner 10 archives. Nothing closed yet as far as triage has read.
note: Starts after close-replaced-at-open. Goal: open PRs are live work only. Test: no live (unarchived) session owns the draft PR, and no step marked doing names it. Then it closes as stale with a comment that names why; its branch stays, and it reopens on need. The first pass is a preview list for the coordinator's read before any close. Filed from coordinator 21:34 CST, corrected 21:35 CST (dropped a 7-day no-commit test as an unmeasured fixed value). Read-only sort, 12:13 CST Nov 18 (coordinator relay 12:20 CST, owner pick b on page item 950): of 473 open PRs, 0 name a merged replacement (91 name another PR) and 0 have every file equal to main (23 have some), so 0 are closable by either signal. Nothing closed. Rows are in the coordinator's scratchpad orphan-rows.json and content-on-main.json. Next signal, the coordinator's: a roadmap step landed through another PR.
